fields.statement: Every CollectionMapAttributeBase-decorated property on a model type read through ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler must be satisfied by a corresponding trailing data-reader result set, consumed in the order Mapper.GetCollectionMapProperties returns them for that model type — ascending PropertyInfo.MetadataToken order among the model's own collection properties, which GetCollectionMapProperties computes by explicitly sorting on MetadataToken rather than relying on Type.GetProperties() reflection order — starting immediately after the model's own result set. When the reader reports no further result set for a declared collection property, the compiled hydration delegate throws UnexpectedSqlResultException naming the model and the property, rather than assigning that property an empty collection.
fields.scope: Mapper.ModelFromReaderWithCollectionsHandler, its compiled per-model-type collection-hydration delegate, and Mapper.GetCollectionMapProperties, which establishes the ordering (ArgentSea.Shared/src/Mapping/Mapper.cs)
